items.name: Clay-Child Charm
items.lore: A little clay figure, fingerprints still on it. Small fingerprints.

items.name: Clay Jotun Bracer
items.lore: Fired clay, hard as iron. It came from something that was nearly alive.

items.name: Swamp-Mother's Shawl
items.lore: Thorgunna's shawl. She wore it to the ford every year.

items.name: Shaper's Ring
items.lore: Taken from the hand of a clay jotun shaper. Everything you touch, for a moment, seems soft.

items.name: Leg-Biter Hilt-Ring
items.lore: The pommel-ring of an ancient sword, worn now as a ring. It hums when blood is spilled.

items.name: Barrow-Dark Cloak
items.lore: The hagbui sleep in cloaks like this. You don't.

items.name: Ketil's Rune-Belt
items.lore: A belt carved with the runes of a family that went into the dark and came out.

items.name: Hagbui Thane Torc
items.lore: Barrow-gold. Cold enough to make your teeth ache.

items.name: Runemistress' Bracer
items.lore: Gunnvor's own. Rune-carved and spell-hard.

items.name: Mud-Crab Shell Bracer
items.lore: Crab-shell plates, lacquered black.

items.name: Swamp-Warden's Ring
items.lore: Bog-iron, the Wardens' raven on it.

items.name: Viper-Fang Torc
items.lore: Two fangs, still faintly wet.

items.name: Reed-Walker's Belt
items.lore: Woven reeds over leather.

items.name: Clay-Jotun Knuckle Ring
items.lore: A ring of fired clay, very hard.

items.name: Pit-Digger's Belt
items.lore: Mud-caked, iron-buckled.

items.name: Broken-Chain Bracer
items.lore: A cut length of hagbui chain, worn as a bracer.

items.name: Jotun-Tear Charm
items.lore: A grey stone. They say it's a jotun's tear.

items.name: Crippled Giant's Ring
items.lore: A ring big enough for a thumb. A jotun's little finger, once.

items.name: Rune-Lifted Mantle
items.lore: Grey, with Gunnvor's runes of unbinding.

items.name: Orm-Runner's Whip-Belt
items.lore: A jotun's whip, cut down to a belt.

items.name: Enslaved Orm Scale Charm
items.lore: A dull green scale, scarred by a harness.

items.name: Outcast's Frost-Torc
items.lore: Iron rimed with frost that never melts.

items.name: Ice-Hauler's Bracer
items.lore: Fur over iron.

items.name: King's Huscarl Mantle
items.lore: The King's blue, heavy wool. Gisli's spare.

items.name: Spider-Silk Mantle
items.lore: Grey silk, very strong.

items.name: Rune-Thread Ring
items.lore: Spider-silk wound round a rune-stone.

items.name: Barrow-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Silver, against the dead.

items.name: Berserker-Bane Belt
items.lore: Heavy leather, iron-studded.

items.name: Spiritmaster's Bone Charm
items.lore: A finger-bone, wound with rune-thread.

items.name: Barrow-Ward Bracer
items.lore: Rowan and silver, against the dead.

items.name: Runemaster's Black Torc
items.lore: Black iron, cold, carved with barrow-runes - now broken.

items.name: Hrafnsholm Warden's Mantle
items.lore: The Wardens' raven, black on grey.

items.name: Thane-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: A hagbui thane's ring, the runes ground off.

items.name: Watch-Hold Scout's Ring
items.lore: Bog-iron, the Wardens' raven.

items.name: Wardens' Oath-Belt
items.lore: The Wardens' belt, given to those who stand with them.
